title: "Session 6 · Analyse: from sample to answer"

**Date:** 05/12/2026

## Agenda

- Recap quiz on Session 5 (10 min)
- 6.1 From sample to population: CI, p-value, power, sample size, choosing a test
- 6.2 Compare groups in the course dataset (live R demo)
- 6.3 Relationships and models: regression, Kaplan-Meier and Cox
- 6.4 Model the course dataset: adjusted OR, Cox HR, missing data, the SAP
- Proposal builder 6: sample size, analysis plan, missing-data plan

## Timetable

| Start | Clock* | Min | Segment |
|:----|:----|---:|:------------------------------------------------------------|
| 0:00 | 08:00 | 10 | Recap quiz |
| 0:10 | 08:10 | 40 | **6.1 From sample to population:** CI, p-values & misinterpretations, type I/II errors, power, sample size (**live demo**), choosing a test, paired vs unpaired, multiple comparisons |
| 0:50 | 08:50 | 20 | **6.2 [DS] Compare groups in the course dataset:** live demo (t-test / Mann–Whitney / chi-square); groups interpret their outputs |
| 1:10 | 09:10 | 15 | BREAK |
| 1:25 | 09:25 | 35 | **6.3 Relationships and models:** correlation, linear and logistic regression, adjustment, interaction, overfitting, Kaplan–Meier & Cox, prediction/ML; reading regression tables & forest plots |
| 2:00 | 10:00 | 25 | **6.4 [DS] Model the course dataset:** crude vs adjusted OR (confounding by indication made visible), Kaplan–Meier + Cox HR, complete-case vs multiple imputation; the SAP that was written before the analysis |
| 2:25 | 10:25 | 30 | **Proposal builder 6:** sample size, analysis plan, missing-data plan |
| 2:55 | 10:55 | 5 | Wrap-up |

\*Times are relative to the start of the session; the clock column shows an example 08:00–11:00 session. **[DS]** = course-dataset content (FLUID-ICU analysis and manuscript writing).
